main.note: 京师 from the north: the 北驿道 comes down from 玉螺湖村 between two small woods to the 北门 in the north wall, its guards on either side inside. 大栅栏 runs south to the 十字路口, where 护国道 crosses from the 西一门 to the 东一门 (旺金钱庄 and the 武器店 north of it, 护国寺 north-west, never written). South of the crossing the axis goes past the 皇家祭坛 (walked round), 神武门 (chained), the walled 紫禁城 (no way in), 午门 between its lions, the 校武场 and the 天桥's market to the south street (西二门 to 东二门) and on past 刑场 and 监狱 (never written) to the 南门. The 西街 (废园, 四喜绸缎庄, 太白酒楼, 相国府's shut gate) and 东街 (振远总局, 尚书府's great compound, 京师 B) run either side of the palace. The five outer gates stand shut: the guards let no one out.
